name: Bun thang
summary: Bun thang is a clear rice-noodle broth with Vietnamese ham, shredded chicken, and strips of omelette. In Hanoi it is a breakfast.
origin: Hanoi. The bowl started as a way to use food left from Lunar New Year.
culture: Unfinished Tết food became a local breakfast. That is the story the city’s dish list prints.
howToEat: A few slices of Vietnamese ham, shredded chicken, omelette strips, and a clear broth.
where: Bún thang Bà Đức, 48 Cầu Gỗ. The hour is check on arrival.
seoTitle: Bun thang — Hanoi breakfast noodle broth
seoDescription: Bun thang in Hanoi is a clear broth with ham, shredded chicken, and omelette, eaten at breakfast. The dish list points to 48 Cầu Gỗ.
